reapack.name: LV1_Track_Importer.lua
reapack.desc: LV1 Track Importer - connect to a Waves LV1 mixer and create Reaper tracks

version.author: malik-malassis
version.changelog: - Fixed: with ReaImGui 0.10, which is what any fresh install gets, every frame logged two "ImGui_PushFont: expected 3 arguments minimum" errors. PushFont changed signature in 0.10 and the script now reads the version instead of trying both forms. - The ReaImGui version is shown in Settings > Advanced, so a bug report carries the one detail that explains this class of problem.
